dedupe_keys.name: btk electronic communications market data and official quarterly statistics turkiye

description: The Information and Communication Technologies Authority, Türkiye's telecoms regulator, publishes two quarterly national series. The official statistics page (İletişim Hizmetleri İstatistikleri) gives, for each quarter from 2016 to the first quarter of 2026, a statistics table, a news bulletin and a metadata document. The Q1 2026 table compares the quarter with a year earlier: 416 operators, sector revenue and investment, 8.3 million fixed lines, 86.0 million mobile subscribers excluding M2M plus 12.3 million M2M lines, 99.5 million broadband subscriptions split into mobile, xDSL (8.3 million), fibre (10.3 million) and cable, fixed and mobile voice minutes, ARPU, and broadband data traffic of 25.4 million TB (4.9 million TB mobile and 20.6 million TB fixed), with monthly traffic per subscriber of 20.8 GB mobile and 322 GB fixed. The longer Electronic Communications Market Data reports, in Turkish and English, add operator market shares, infrastructure such as fibre length and base stations, and international comparisons, at 13 to 39 MB per PDF. Coverage: Türkiye, national. Format and access: PDF tables, DOC and DOCX metadata and PDF reports, free. Caveats: there are no spreadsheets for the quarterly tables; the English market reports cover only the latest few quarters; definitions change, for example over M2M. Simulation uses: national demand and traffic growth for capacity planning, and fixed-to-mobile and fibre substitution trends. Related records: the BTK provincial annual statistics give the same indicators by province; the ITU ICT statistics and OECD broadband databases give international comparisons.
